description: Network diagnostics toolkit: ping, traceroute, DNS, LAN scan, port scan & more NetLens is a comprehensive network diagnostics toolkit for Android. Inspect, diagnose, and monitor your network from a single app — no ads, no tracking, fully open-source. Network Info - IP Info — look up your public IP address and geolocation - WHOIS — query domain and IP ownership records Connectivity - Ping — test latency and reachability with single or continuous mode - DNS Lookup — query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, and other record types - Traceroute — trace the full network path to any host Discovery - LAN Scan — discover devices on your local network with MAC vendor identification - mDNS Browser — find Bonjour and .local services on the network - Port Scanner — scan for open TCP ports on any target Security & Web - TLS Inspector — inspect SSL/TLS certificates and cipher suites - HTTP Tester — send custom HTTP requests and inspect responses Tools - Wake-on-LAN — send magic packets to wake network devices - Endpoint Monitor — track uptime and latency of HTTP endpoints over time - Network Log — view connection history and network events - History — browse past scan results with search and filtering Home Screen Widget Configurable widget for at-a-glance network status right on your home screen. Built with Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and modern Android architecture. Requires Android 10+. Open Source Licensed under AGPL-3.0. Source code available on GitHub.
